paragraphs.en: After the battle, only three men remained alive: Hunter, a pirate, and Captain Smollett. The third mutineer died during surgery. Hunter lingered all day but eventually passed away in his sleep due to severe injuries.
paragraphs.zh: 经过这场战斗，仅剩三人幸存：海盗亨特、船长斯莫莱特以及另一位叛变的水手。那位叛变的水手在手术过程中不幸去世。亨特拖了整整一天，最终在睡梦中因伤势过重而离世。

paragraphs.en: Captain Smollett's wounds were serious but not life-threatening. He would recover, though he needed rest and could not move his arm for weeks.
paragraphs.zh: 斯莫莱特船长的伤势虽重但还不至于危及生命。他能够康复，不过需要好好休息，至少几周都不能动用胳膊。

paragraphs.en: My minor injury was just a superficial cut on my knuckles, which the doctor quickly treated with plaster.
paragraphs.zh: 我的小伤只是手背上的一个小口子，医生很快就用绷带包扎好了。

paragraphs.en: After dinner, Squire and Doctor Livesey consulted by the captain’s side. When they finished, around noon, Doctor Livesey left, armed and carrying a chart and musket.
paragraphs.zh: 吃过晚饭后，斯科特爵士和莱维斯克医生在船长身边商量了一阵。等到中午时分，莱维斯克医生带着武器，拿着航海图和火枪离开了。

paragraphs.en: Gray and I sat quietly at the far end of the blockhouse to avoid overhearing their discussion. Gray was stunned when he saw Doctor Livesey depart.
paragraphs.zh: 格雷和我静静地坐在掩体的远端，以免听到他们的讨论。当格雷看到莱维斯医生离开时，不禁惊叫道。

paragraphs.en: "Why in the name of Davy Jones," Gray exclaimed, "is Dr. Livesey going?"
paragraphs.zh: “天杀的戴维·琼斯在上，”格雷脱口而出，“莱西医生这是要去哪儿？”

paragraphs.en: "I don't think he's mad," I replied. "He’s not one for such rash actions."
paragraphs.zh: “我认为他不至于疯了，”我说，“他不会做出如此冲动的事。”

paragraphs.en: Gray said, "He may not be mad, but if he isn't, mark my words, I am." I thought to myself that the doctor must have his own idea, and indeed, as it turned out later, he was heading to see Ben Gunn.
paragraphs.zh: 格雷说：“他可能没疯，但要是没疯的话，我可以发誓自己疯了。”我想着医生肯定有自己的打算，果然后来他去了本·古恩那里。

paragraphs.en: The heat inside the house was unbearable, and the sand patch under the palisade was baking in the sun. Envy began to grow within me as I envied the doctor walking through the cool woods with birds around him and the pleasant scent of pine. Meanwhile, I sat grilling, my clothes stuck to hot resin, surrounded by blood and dead bodies.
paragraphs.zh: 屋内的暑热令人难以忍受，栅栏下的沙地在阳光下炙烤着。我心中涌起了一股羡慕之情，眼见医生漫步于凉爽的林间小道，四周鸟语花香，空气中弥漫着清新的松木香气。而我却只能坐在那里煎熬，衣服被滚烫的树脂粘住，周围是鲜血和腐烂的尸体。

paragraphs.en: While washing out the blockhouse and cleaning up from dinner, this disgust intensified. Near a bread bag, unnoticed, I filled both pockets with biscuits as a precautionary measure. Though foolish, I was determined to take all possible precautions.
paragraphs.zh: 在清理炮台和收拾晚餐残局时，这种厌恶之情愈发强烈。我注意到一个面包袋旁边，便不引人注意地将两口袋都塞满了饼干，以防万一。虽然这么做显得有些愚蠢，但我还是决定采取所有可能的预防措施。

paragraphs.en: If anything happened, these biscuits would at least keep me from starving for some time.
paragraphs.zh: 如果真出了什么岔子，这些饼干至少能让我撑一阵子不饿死。

paragraphs.en: I grabbed two pistols, already having a powder-horn and bullets. My plan seemed reasonable: find the white rock where Ben Gunn had hidden his boat on the sandy spit dividing the anchorage from the open sea. However, I knew I wouldn't be allowed to leave the enclosure.
paragraphs.zh: 我抓起两把手枪，已经备好了火药壶和子弹。我的计划看似合情合理：找到本·古恩藏船的那块白岩石，位于码头与开阔海之间的沙洲上。然而，我知道自己不会被允许离开这个封闭区域。

paragraphs.en: My only option was to take French leave when no one was watching, which was a poor way of doing it.
paragraphs.zh: 唯一的办法就是在没人注意的时候擅自离开，这种方式未免太不地道了。

paragraphs.en: Despite being just a boy, I made up my mind to go through with it.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管只是一个孩子，我毅然决定要亲自去做。

paragraphs.en: I seized a perfect opportunity when the squire and Gray were occupied with the captain's bandages. I slipped over the stockade into the dense forest and quickly disappeared before anyone noticed.
paragraphs.zh: 我抓住了绝佳时机，当管家和格雷忙于为船长包扎伤口时，我悄悄越过高墙，钻进了浓密的森林中，很快就消失不见了。

paragraphs.en: This mistake left only two men guarding the house, but it was crucial for our survival. Determined to avoid observation from the anchorage, I headed straight towards the eastern coast of the island.
paragraphs.zh: 这个失误只剩下两名男子守卫房子，但这对于我们来说至关重要。为了避开海港的监视，我直接向岛屿东海岸进发。

paragraphs.en: By late afternoon, though still warm and sunny, a stronger sea breeze had begun. The continuous sound of waves and rustling leaves indicated the wind's increased strength. Soon, cool breezes reached me as I emerged into an open grove, where the sea stretched blue to the horizon.
paragraphs.zh: 到下午晚些时候，虽然天气依旧温暖明媚，但海风却更加强烈了。连续不断的海浪声和树叶的沙沙声表明风力在逐渐增强。不久，当我步入一片开阔的林地时，凉爽的微风迎面而来，海面延伸至天边，蔚蓝一片。

paragraphs.en: I had never seen such turbulent seas on Treasure Island. Even when the sun shone and the air was still, powerful waves crashed along the coast day and night.
paragraphs.zh: 我从未在藏宝岛见过如此汹涌的海面。即使阳光普照，风平浪静，强劲的波涛依然日夜拍打着海岸。

paragraphs.en: Walking beside the surf with great pleasure, I moved southward until I found a thick bush for cover. From there, I cautiously climbed up to the spit's ridge.
paragraphs.zh: 怀着极大的愉悦沿着海浪漫步，我向南走了一段路，直到发现一片密集的灌木丛作为掩护。然后，我小心翼地点身爬上了岬角的顶端。

paragraphs.en: Behind me lay the sea; ahead, the anchorage. The unusual strength of the sea breeze had subsided, replaced by light, variable southerly winds and dense fog. The HISPANIOLA, clearly visible in the calm waters, was exactly as we first saw it, under the lee of Skeleton Island.
paragraphs.zh: 在我身后是浩瀚的海洋，而前方则是停泊区。那不寻常强劲的海风已经减弱，取而代之的是轻柔多变的南风和浓重的雾气。在平静的水面上，HISPANIOLA号清晰可见，正如我们初次见到时的模样，正位于骷髅岛的背风处。

paragraphs.en: Captain Flint’s gig lay nearby with Silver in the stern-sheets. Two men were leaning over the stern bulwarks; one wore a red cap—the same rogue I had seen earlier striding on the palisade. They seemed to be talking and laughing, though from my distance of over a mile, I couldn’t hear their words.
paragraphs.zh: 弗林特船长的小划子停在不远处，锡尔弗坐在船尾。有两个男人正倚靠在船舷上，其中一个戴着红帽子——正是我刚才在木栅栏上见过的那个家伙。他们似乎在交谈并笑个不停，不过从我一英里之外的距离来看，根本听不清他们在说什么。

paragraphs.en: Suddenly, a terrible, unearthly scream pierced the air, startling me momentarily before I recognized Captain Flint’s voice. The bird perched on his wrist was easily identifiable by its bright plumage.
paragraphs.zh: 突然，一声恐怖而异乎寻常的尖叫声穿透了空气，让我一惊，随后我才认出那是弗林特船长的声音。他手腕上停着的那只鸟因为色彩鲜艳很容易辨认出来。

paragraphs.en: Shortly after, the jolly-boat pulled away and headed for shore. The man in the red cap and his companion went below through the cabin companion.
paragraphs.zh: 不一会儿，那只划得兴高采烈的小船离开了，朝岸边驶去。戴红帽子的男子和他的同伴则通过船舱 Companion 下到了下面。

paragraphs.en: As the sun set behind the Spy-glass and fog gathered rapidly, it grew dark quickly. I realized I had to find the boat that evening without delay.
paragraphs.zh: 随着太阳在望远镜后西沉，浓雾迅速聚拢，天色很快暗了下来。我意识到当晚必须赶紧找到那条船。

paragraphs.en: The white rock, visible above the brush, was still about a quarter of a mile down the spit. Crawling among the scrub, often on all fours, took me some time. By nightfall, my hand touched the rough sides of the rock.
paragraphs.zh: 那块白色的岩石在灌木之上隐约可见，但距离仍有四分之一英里远。我在灌木丛中爬行，有时四肢着地，花了好一阵子才到达。夜幕降临之际，我的手终于触到了岩石粗糙的表面。

paragraphs.en: Below it, I found a small hollow covered by banks and thick undergrowth knee-deep in vegetation. In the center of this dell stood a little tent made of goat-skins—like those gipsies carry in England.
paragraphs.zh: 在下面，我发现了一个被灌木和茂密的植被覆盖的小凹地。这个小凹地中央竖立着一座用山羊皮制成的小帐篷——就像英国吉普赛人携带的那种。

paragraphs.en: I dropped into the hollow, lifted the side of the tent, and discovered Ben Gunn’s boat—a homemade affair with a lop-sided framework of tough wood and a covering of goat-skin inside. The boat was extremely small, barely fitting me, and I doubted it could support a full-sized man. It had one low thwart, a stretcher in the bows, and a double paddle for propulsion.
paragraphs.zh: 我跳进那个凹坑，掀开帐篷的一侧，发现是本·古恩的独木舟——这是一艘自制的小船，框架由几根坚韧的木材构成，形状有些歪斜，在里面还覆盖着羊皮。这艘小船非常狭小，勉强能容下我一个人，我不确定它能否承受一个成年男子的重量。船上只有一个低矮的横档、船首的一张简易躺椅，以及一根双面桨用于划行。

paragraphs.en: I hadn’t seen a coracle before but have since—Ben Gunn’s boat resembled the first and worst ever made by man. However, its great advantage was that it was exceedingly light and portable.
paragraphs.zh: 我以前从未见过独木舟，但后来见过——班·古恩的船就像人类制造出的第一只也是最糟糕的独木舟。不过，它的优点是极其轻便且易于携带。

paragraphs.en: I had found the boat and decided to act despite the risks. Determined to prevent the mutineers from leaving Treasure Island, I planned to cut the HISPANIOLA adrift under cover of night. The fog provided perfect conditions; as daylight faded, absolute darkness enveloped the island.
paragraphs.zh: 我找到了那条船，并决定冒险一试。为了阻止叛乱分子逃离 treasure 岛，我计划在夜幕掩护下将“逆水号”松绑放走。雾气提供了绝佳的条件；随着天色渐暗，整个岛屿陷入了绝对的黑暗中。

paragraphs.en: Sitting by my coracle, I ate a hearty meal of biscuit. At last, with the sky hidden in fog, I shouldered the small boat and stumbled out into the anchorage. Only two points were visible: one was the fire on shore where the defeated pirates feasted, and the other a faint light from the anchored ship.
paragraphs.zh: 坐在独木舟旁，我吃了一顿丰盛的饼干餐。终于，在雾气弥漫中天色昏暗下来，我扛起小船，踉跄着走进了停泊区。只见两点微光：一点是岸上篝火旁海盗们正在欢宴，另一点则是锚泊船只发出的隐约光芒。

paragraphs.en: The ebb tide had already run for some time. Wading through swampy sand, sinking several times above my ankle, I reached the edge of the receding water. With strength and dexterity, I set the coracle on the surface, keel downwards.
paragraphs.zh: 退潮已经持续了一段时间。我涉过泥泞的沙地，脚踝多次被陷住，终于来到了退水的边缘。凭借着力气和技巧，我把独木舟稳稳地搁在了水面上，船底朝下。
